Fluentd is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2018.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [cluster-kubernetes](@/work/cluster-kubernetes.md): Kubernetes Cluster.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Fluentd: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Fluentd to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
